verdict.label: benign
verdict.description: Postinstall helper for native binary validation and optional wasm fallback.

behaviors.behavior: Reads package.json to identify target module name
behaviors.analysis: Script reads INIT_CWD/package.json to determine if it's @swc/core or @swc/workspace, allowing conditional logic.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate module identification for post-install behavior.

behaviors.behavior: Executes npm install command to download @swc/wasm as fallback
behaviors.analysis: Uses execSync to run npm install --no-save for @swc/wasm, a standard dependency resolution pattern.
behaviors.impact: Installs missing native wasm binary if not present; no exfiltration.

behaviors.behavior: Removes temporary installation directory after operation
behaviors.analysis: Uses fs.readdirSync, lstatSync, unlinkSync, and rmdirSync to clean up temp directory.
behaviors.impact: Standard cleanup behavior; no persistence or privilege escalation.

decision.label: benign
reasons: Install path not fully reviewed; human review required
